name: PRIVREP-a-route-open

name: PRIVREP-the-guest-let-in
note: A guest - a device one storage clear from gone - would send reports nobody can follow up.

name: PRIVREP-a-word-with-no-sentence

new: if (false) return { ok: true, repeat: true, id: prior.id, sentAt: prior.sent_at };

name: PRIVREP-the-context-stored-raw
note: Whatever a client put beside the words would be kept - an agent string, a location - not the three fields the form says it sends.

name: PRIVREP-the-words-uncleaned
note: Control characters and Windows line ends would be stored and drawn in the reader's window.

name: PRIVREP-the-send-read-at-4KiB

name: PRIVREP-the-open-bound-uncounted
note: Sends racing past the count read before the insert would land past REPORT_OPEN_MAX - the insert's own bound is what holds a race (AUDIT PRIVATE-REPORT SVC-1 SVC-3).

name: PRIVREP-the-open-bound-counting-closed
note: A reporter whose reports were fixed would be refused for good - their record held against them.

name: PRIVREP-the-rows-answered-raw
note: The list would answer the table's columns, not the head the client reads.

name: PRIVREP-the-reader-check-gone
note: Every registered player would read every report.

name: PRIVREP-a-missing-list-read-as-everyones
note: An empty or unset list would open the inbox to everyone, not to nobody.

name: PRIVREP-the-close-unscoped
note: Closing one report would close every report.

name: PRIVREP-the-counts-for-everyone
note: Every player's box would say how many exploits wait - and cost every heartbeat a statement.

name: PRIVREP-the-heartbeat-without-the-config

note: A lost answer asked again would be a second report of the same words.

name: PRIVREP-the-rid-kept-past-a-changed-draft
note: A kind changed after a lost answer would be answered with the old kind's report - the new one never sent (AUDIT PRIVATE-REPORT TEST-6).

name: PRIVREP-the-draft-kept-after-a-send
note: A report sent would sit in the form, one press from being sent again.

name: PRIVREP-the-envelope-blind-to-reports
note: A reader's envelope would never light for a report waiting.

name: PRIVREP-the-rise-never-said
note: A report would come in and nobody would be told on the world tab.

name: PRIVREP-the-form-rebuilt-on-every-draw
note: Every heartbeat while a player typed would rebuild the form under them - the caret lost, the focus thrown.

name: PRIVREP-the-doors-gone
note: No player could find the report form from the mailbox.

name: PRIVREP-the-inbox-door-for-everyone
note: A reporter's mailbox would draw a door to an inbox that is not theirs (and throw on its missing count).

name: PRIVREP-the-close-never-asked

note: A reader's Fixed would close nothing: the reporter would never hear it was fixed.

name: PRIVREP-bug-read-as-the-mailbox
note: `/bug` would open the mailbox and leave the player to find the form.

name: PRIVREP-the-classic-skin-without-a-way-in
note: `/bug` on the classic skin would open a pause window with no mailbox in it.

name: PRIVREP-the-law-counting-utf16
note: An emoji would count twice: a title of 41 emoji refused that the table takes, and the form's counter off by one an emoji (AUDIT PRIVATE-REPORT SVC-1).

name: PRIVREP-the-words-cleaned-by-a-second-law
note: A title of three zero-width spaces, or a direction override, would pass a private control-character strip (AUDIT PRIVATE-REPORT SVC-2).

name: PRIVREP-a-tab-glued
note: Two words a tab apart would be read as one (wire.js visibleText drops a tab as a control character) (AUDIT PRIVATE-REPORT SVC-2).

name: PRIVREP-the-bound-moved
note: The bound would move without the refusal's sentence and the record that say 20 (AUDIT PRIVATE-REPORT TEST-11).

name: PRIVREP-the-rate-counted-before-the-full-queue
note: A send refused for a full queue would cost one of the hour's five, and a report closed meanwhile still be refused report-rate (AUDIT PRIVATE-REPORT SVC-3).

name: PRIVREP-the-precount-counting-closed
note: A reporter whose reports were fixed would be refused for good by the count read before the insert.

name: PRIVREP-one-rate-for-everyone
note: Five reports an hour would be the whole game's, not an account's (AUDIT PRIVATE-REPORT TEST-2).

name: PRIVREP-the-window-a-minute
note: The hour's bound would be a minute's (AUDIT PRIVATE-REPORT TEST-2).

name: PRIVREP-newest-first-alone

name: PRIVREP-the-closed-list-fixed-alone
note: A report closed as Won't fix or Duplicate would vanish from every list (AUDIT PRIVATE-REPORT TEST-7).

name: PRIVREP-the-closed-list-oldest-first
note: The last closed would be at the end of a list a hundred long (AUDIT PRIVATE-REPORT TEST-7).

name: PRIVREP-a-second-readers-read-over-the-first

new: await db.prepare('UPDATE private_reports SET read_at = ?, read_by = ? WHERE id = ?')

name: PRIVREP-a-closes-read-over-the-first
note: A close would stamp the report read at the close, over the first reader's opening (AUDIT PRIVATE-REPORT TEST-8).

name: PRIVREP-the-counts-counting-closed
note: The envelope would count every report ever closed, for good (AUDIT PRIVATE-REPORT TEST-9).

name: PRIVREP-no-next-page
note: Past a hundred open reports the oldest unopened one would never be reached (AUDIT PRIVATE-REPORT SVC-4).

name: PRIVREP-the-page-ignored
note: Every page asked for would be the first (AUDIT PRIVATE-REPORT SVC-4).

name: PRIVREP-the-mine-limit-gone
note: A reporter's list would carry every report they ever sent (AUDIT PRIVATE-REPORT TEST-15).

name: PRIVREP-the-draft-cleared-of-words-typed-mid-send

name: PRIVREP-the-desk-kept-past-a-switch-by-itself

name: PRIVREP-an-answer-for-a-session-gone-taken
note: A reader's inbox asked under one account and answered after another signed in would be drawn for the other (AUDIT PRIVATE-REPORT CLI-1).

name: PRIVREP-the-newest-look-overwritten-by-an-older
note: An older inbox look answering last would put a report just closed back in the open list (AUDIT PRIVATE-REPORT CLI-4).

name: PRIVREP-the-inbox-kept-past-not-report-reader
note: A reader taken off the list would keep the inbox and the whole reports they had opened, drawn from this copy (AUDIT PRIVATE-REPORT CLI-1).

name: PRIVREP-the-next-page-in-place-of-the-first
note: "Show older reports" would swap the first hundred for the next (AUDIT PRIVATE-REPORT SVC-4).

name: PRIVREP-a-second-close-while-one-is-out
note: A second press would send a second close, and both lists' looks twice (AUDIT PRIVATE-REPORT UI-8).

name: PRIVREP-the-desks-counts-never-the-envelopes

name: PRIVREP-the-desk-kept-past-a-switch-by-the-box

name: PRIVREP-the-counter-in-utf16-units

name: PRIVREP-the-focus-left-after-a-send

name: PRIVREP-the-old-pane-saying-the-send

name: PRIVREP-read-never-said-to-the-reporter

name: PRIVREP-the-button-never-shown

name: PRIVREP-a-failed-look-silent-over-a-list

name: PRIVREP-the-closes-live-while-one-is-out

name: PRIVREP-the-repeat-eaten-in-a-field

name: PRIVREP-the-send-read-past-its-bound

name: PRIVREP-another-reader-named
